text:
Lena (Support): FYI launching an escalation — multiple trial customers can't finish onboarding because webhook verification fails with 422. Seeing 47 distinct accounts in the last 12h.
Sam (CS): Which customers are hitting this? Any paid accounts?
Lena (Support): Mostly early-stage trials. Flagged two renewals that start next month: Cooperix (renewal in 28 days) and Meridian Health (renewal risk). Both showed activation stuck at 'waiting for webhook'.
Arjun (Solutions): Can you paste the response body from the webhook verification?
Lena (Support): ```
HTTP 422 
{"error":"invalid_signature","detail":"signature mismatch - expected HMAC sha256"}
headers: x-signature: sha256=... , x-timestamp: 1670000000
client: webhooks-signer v1.0.3
```
Tess (Legal): If we proactively reach out and offer credits, check contract terms for trial credits vs refunds. Loop me in the message.
Sam (CS): Agreed. Proposed triage & comms plan: 1) Solutions to identify whether the signer library/regression (Arjun) - goal: 4 hours; 2) Support to publish KB and temporary verification bypass (Lena) - goal: 2 hours; 3) CS to notify impacted renewals + provide direct contact and trial credit offer if activation delayed (Sam) - goal: today EOD; 4) Legal to approve credit wording (Tess) - goal: 6 hours.
Lena (Support): Workaround we validated: users can reissue webhook secret from dashboard and re-register endpoint; signatures then pass. We can document this step-by-step.
Arjun (Solutions): Noting many of the failing headers are missing the x-timestamp. Likely a client-side SDK v1.0.3 bug where timestamp isn't included if request body is empty. I'll open a PR to validate and patch signing lib.
Sam (CS): Draft outreach (short): "We9re investigating an intermittent webhook verification issue that may block activation. Temporary workaround: reissue webhook secret in Console and re-register the endpoint; contact us directly if you need help. We9ll follow up with a fix ETA and will credit affected trials where activation was prevented."
Tess (Legal): Approve tone. Replace "credit" with "trial credit or account extension" and include a link to the billing terms. Also cc account execs for Cooperix and Meridian.
Lena (Support): I will create KB with screenshots + a small checklist for Support to walk customers through reissuing secrets. Will attach a short survey link to capture blocking steps.
support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-5110 9Webhook Verification Failures9 - bridge: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-5110 - priority: P2
Arjun (Solutions): Spun up a canary with patched signer that adds timestamp. Early tests pass for the sample payloads. Rolling a staged runtime deploy in 30m with dark traffic to measure.
Sam (CS): I9ll start proactive outreach to the top-20 impacted accounts and loop account execs. Sending templated note now and will post copy here.
Lena (Support): If customers ask for immediate help, Support should use the admin "reissue secret" flow and validate signature with our test endpoint. I9ll pin steps in the KB.
Sam (CS): Enablement for CS/Support at 3pm PT to walk through the KB and credit policy. Invite sent. Add any account-specific talking points in this thread.
Arjun (Solutions): ETA for root cause confirmation: 2 hours. If rollback is needed we can revert the signer change in the next hour.
Sam (CS): Thanks team. Tag me if you see cancellation language or contract termination talk. We should escalate to Sales leadership immediately in that case.
Lena (Support): Will update thread with customer responses and KB link once live.
Tess (Legal): I9ll prepare the standard credit wording and a short approval matrix so CS can issue credits quickly if needed.
Arjun (Solutions): Update: rolled out dark traffic for 15m, error rate dropped to baseline. Preparing patch PR for canary release.
Sam (CS): Great. Keep updates here. We9ll track activation/resolution metrics and post a follow-up summary after the incident is closed.
